27728.overview:
Kidou Senshi Gundam Seed is an action game with 8 stages. The player controls the Strike Gundam, while trying to destroy Gin and Shigu of Zaft's mobile suits and enemy Gundam on the stages of colonies, outer space and desert!

Strike Gundam can be modified with optional parts according to the situation, so consider the characteristics of each equipment, such as focusing on mobility with an ale striker pack, close combat with a sword striker pack or firepower with a launcher striker pack.

After clearing the game with Strike Gundam, you can play the side stories of Aegis Gundam, Duel Gundam, Blitz Gundam, Buster Gundam, and the new Freedom Gundam.

27738.overview: This remake of SaGa features several changes compared to the original. The graphics have been updated to 16-bit level, with new sprites and artwork drawn by Toshiyuki Itahana. New animated sequences have been added to the game as well as an intro sequence. Other new features include the ability to see what a monster would change to if they eat a new meat ahead of time, a bestiary, and the ability to re-target enemies when a previous target is slain by another character. There's even an option to play a straight port of the original Game Boy version as well.

27751.overview: Saint Seiya Golden Legend and Golden Legend Complete Edition released on NES from 1987 and 1988 are revived in Wonderswan! This Perfect Edition combines the two NES versions into one with new graphics. In addition, the strongest enemy of Golden Legends that did not appear in the NES version has been added to the game.

27752.overview:
Released simultaneously with SD Gundam Eiyuuden: Musha Densetsu, the two initially start out as separate stories with completely different worldviews, but as the story approaches the end, both stories are combined to an unified ending.

Kishi Densetsu begins in the town of Lacroix, where an annual festival is held. In the middle of the festival, the Zard Army that suddenly died 10 years ago, aims at the legendary knight Gundam left in Lacroix.

The main character, Mine, gets into the legendary knight Gundam and challenges Breston to a battle in order to compete with one of the four kings of the Zad Western invasion army.

27753.overview:
Released simultaneously with SD Gundam Eiyuuden: Kishi Densetsu, the two initially start out as separate stories with completely different worldviews, but as the story approaches the end, both stories are combined to an unified ending.

Musha Densetsu begins when the Tengen General and Tengu are suddenly attacked by the revived Zard Army. The Tennomiya Army manages to attack the Zard Army with the help of their young warriors. Among them, the one that took over the warrior Gundam has the power to overwhelm the leader Zanche of the Four Heavenly Kings of the Zade Eastern Invasion Army.

27754.overview: Operation U.C. is a scrolling shooter. Take control of the original, Zeta, or ZZ Gundam and fight against their respective rivals.

27755.overview: Gather Beat 2 is a strategy game with an original storyline. It includes content from Mobile Suit Gundam and sub stories such as 0080, 0083 and 08.

27756.overview:
The final Wonderswan entry in the G Generation franchise. As opposed to the console games, Monoeye Gundams features an original crossover plot.

The game begins at the end of the One Year War, when the main character Sig Wedner is a pilot in the Zeon army. Sig fights the One Year War with his comrades, including Sera Iskperi and Ein Levy, but at the end of the One Year War, Ein suddenly betrays Sig, which results in Sig being seriously injured and Sera being reduced to ashes.

Seven years later, Sig has become a soldier for Aegon and is fighting the Titans under Char. The fate of a woman who appears to be dead (Sera), is about to bring them together again...

27757.overview: This is an RPG with a branching storyline. Depending on your progress, you will be able to experience history that can't be found in the original work. Defeat Shamans in battles with your spiritual powers and Shaman energy.

27760.overview:
Soroban Gu is an action puzzle game, in which blocks appearing one after another are aligned and erased. However, the  top, bottom, left, and right of the screen loop in this game. As a result, the blocks will be connected unexpectedly.

The battle mode, which is a classic action puzzle, is also supported. In this mode there are three levels of difficulty, so you can play with friends of different skill levels.

27761.overview:
Star Hearts is a WonderSwan Color exclusive fantasy action role-playing game set in the fictional world of Uras, which has a large floating fortress in the center. The protagonist is selectable by the player at the beginning of the game, either the boy or the girl depicted on the front cover, together with some input such as the name, date of birth, and a blood type. The story starts with the player character about to become the new village chief. The ceremony gets interrupted by a bunch of attacking monsters and the hero barely escapes with their life.

The game uses a 3/4 view where the player moves in a vertical and horizontal way, can interact with other NPCs and fight enemies on the screen using projectiles or blunt weapons. Fighting is done in real-time, and after battling many weaker enemies, one will usually face a boss. While the player starts the game alone, they will get a pet companion, choosable out of four different types, in the middle of the journey. Leveling up is not done through gaining experience from combat, but instead by finding fairies scattered around the land.

27762.overview: Super Robot Wars Compact 3 is the final WonderSwan entry in the strategy RPG series. The game mixes old and new mechanics, while introducing obscure anime series like New Story of Aura Battler Dunbine and Mechander Robo.

27763.overview: First game of the Compact Trilogy, released on the WonderSwan first, and then, with a few gameplay differences, on the WonderSwan Color.

34145.overview:
Hoshin Engi is inspired by the Chinese literary classic Investiture of the Gods, a shenmo novel. The story involves the Chinese mythology and history of China, in particular the last members of the In (Yin Dynasty aka Shang Dynasty) and the plot to overthrow them.

The game is based on manga from 1996-2000, but it has a new protagonist and original storyline.
